rules: This manifest describes dependencies, not permission to execute arbitrary commands.

The fixed workflow subcommand executes four enumerators, DNS enrichment and three archive collectors. The plugin optionally continues through its native gateway; JSON is never interpreted as arbitrary commands.
Every boundary canonicalises, deduplicates and filters to the exact domain or its subdomains; archive URLs are candidates, not evidence of a live service.
Preserve query strings and source/run provenance; remove fragments. Keep DNS names as targets, without implicitly authorising their IPs or CNAME destinations.
All target HTTP producers require governed egress (#44), including redirects, retries and auxiliary connections. Installation or a proxy flag cannot unlock them.
Newly discovered domains and URLs do not expand Burp scope. Import requires a separate current-scope check. AI findings remain unverified candidates.

tools.name: subfinder
tools.detail: All sources supporting recursive queries; bounded provider profile.

tools.name: assetfinder
tools.detail: Subdomains only; positional domain argument.

tools.name: chaos-client (chaos)
tools.detail: Chaos dataset; installed executable is chaos; PDCP_API_KEY/config.

tools.name: amass
tools.detail: Exact Amass v3.23.3 required before enum -passive -json -; unsupported versions fail without enumeration. Isolated stage directory.

tools.name: dnsx
tools.detail: Runs after hostname union. A/AAAA/CNAME metadata remains attached to the hostname; IPs never become implicit scan targets.

tools.name: Waybackpy
tools.detail: Read-only CDX, match-type domain, collapse urlkey, original URLs only. Exclude SavePageNow; the profile never triggers a new capture.

tools.name: waybackurls
tools.detail: Pinned provider-only stdin profile; historical URL candidates, not liveness evidence.

tools.name: urlfinder
tools.detail: Pinned passive JSONL profile, all sources, five provider requests/sec, update checks disabled.

stages.input: resolved_host -> hostname; archive URL; scoped hostname fallback when DNS unavailable

tools.name: httpx
tools.detail: IP, technology, CNAME, TLS, server, title, status, length, location, timing; no automatic redirects or target-expanding TLS/CSP probing in saved plan.

tools.name: Native HTTP probe
tools.detail: Anonymous GET via the shared Burp gateway. One request ledger includes roots, HTTPS transport fallbacks, redirects, crawl and JS fetches. Current Burp scope required; no CLI bypass.

tools.name: whatweb
tools.detail: Offline WhatWeb JSON report-array adapter is available. Even aggression 1 sends target HTTP and follows redirects; CLI execution remains blocked.

tools.name: Native fingerprint signals
tools.detail: Server/title/status/body length/type/timing, DNS metadata and lightweight technology signals from admitted responses. No WhatWeb/Wappalyzer equivalence or TLS certificate-grab claim.

tools.name: katana
tools.detail: Active crawler; existing output adapter/profile remains blocked at process boundary.

tools.name: gospider
tools.detail: Offline JSON output URL adapter is available. Live crawling/JavaScript retrieval remains blocked at process boundary.

tools.name: cariddi
tools.detail: Crawler/endpoint/secret discovery; never execute through a provider-only exception.

tools.name: Native bounded crawler
tools.detail: Depth and URL/queue caps; each redirect and extracted URL is separately scoped/admitted. Shared quota; no form submission, browser execution or PoC payloads.

tools.name: local canonicalise / dedupe
tools.detail: Merge as a union, allowing archive-only candidates when live stages are blocked; preserve queries and provenance, filter scope before any later fetch.

tools.name: JSFinder
tools.detail: Offline -ou URL-export adapter is available. CLI live URL/JavaScript retrieval remains blocked; native captured-JS extraction is available.

tools.name: Native static JS endpoints
tools.detail: Extract endpoints from captured JS, retaining URL escapes/queries. Link candidates do not prove a vulnerability. Captured sources can be staged locally for the existing AI review.

stages.output: unverified candidate report + manual PoC suggestions

tools.name: existing five-agent evidence review
tools.detail: Select/redact evidence and preview provider sharing in AI analysis/Agent team; no automatic provider submission or PoC execution from recon.
